plan: Given my value of $42, I aim to bid just above the expected second-highest value to maximize profit. Assuming uniform distribution, the average value is $24.5. To outbid competitors, I will bid slightly above this average, while ensuring my bid doesn't exceed my value to avoid losses. I will bid $30, balancing between winning the prize and maintaining a profit margin. This should cover most scenarios where at least one bidder values the prize less than average.

Since the value is relatively low, I will bid slightly above half of my value to increase my chances of winning without risking too much of my endowment. This minimizes loss if I win and maximizes profit potential.
